program.name: Forearm Pump
program.subject: Grip & forearms
program.blurb: Arm supersets with a forearm move in every pair: curls, rows and presses for big forearms.
program.about: Arm day with the forearms built in. Every superset pairs a forearm move, wrist curls, reverse curls or a heavy hold, with a curl, a row or a press, then rests. The forearms never fully recover between pairs, which is what makes them grow. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
